text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would it be alright if I went to 
the racetrack to cheer them on today?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
An acquaintance of mine is making her Make 
Debut right out of the gate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, around this time of year, Umamusume 
begin making their debuts one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The classmate making her Make Debut 
fastest is, of course, Admire Vega...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought, but I was wrong.

"Ah, King of the Fairies! Wouldst thou 
command me to tread upon the verdant turf 
swifter than all others?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us be born, and show the world 
the image of a youthful Overlord. Yes—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Behold the majesty of this T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, as expected of youuu! You're 
the race favorite toooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The very first to debut is T.M. Opera O. A 
jovial Opera King who believes his own 
triumphs are the source of the world's 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And over here is Meisho Doto! She's a 
clumsy girl with no confidence, and her 
debut is still far off, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My classmate! And an irreplaceable 
retainer who is essential by my side! For 
now, at least.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm the attendant~. I shall follow 
Opera O-san wherever she goes~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Opera O, who did you introduce me 
to?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, for the audience, of course. 
For my every move is watched at all times!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come—I shall put on a show of utter 
dominance! Behold the flight of this young 
Supreme Overlord!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The overwhelming favorite. And the result 
is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O takes second place~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A crushing defeat by a whopping 6 lengths. 
It seems her form still has a long way to 
go!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ugghhh... *cough*, *wheeze*... Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! It must be so. Sticking 
strictly to the script lacks all 
amusement!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Please look forward to our next act: 
'Rise, Heartbroken Champion Prince! Your 
Tears Are an Ocean to the World!'"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Opera O-chan is...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's so much fun, really! To be able to 
entertain people like this... It's 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Leaving the Holy Hoof Festival in Opera 
O-chan's hands makes me feel completely at 
ease, yep, yep..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's quite an entertainer 
among our classmates too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And a few days later, the main star 
finally makes their entrance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, it's finally time. Your Make 
Debut...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes. But—this is merely a stepping stone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you're dropping easy wins, we have 
nothing to discuss. ...Later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a turn of events! Admire Vega is 
demoted to 4th place! Although she crossed 
the wire first, interference has resulted 
in a demotion!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Is she still struggling to find her 
footing? The shadow hanging over this 
rising star is concerning!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um... Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A mistake is a mistake. But—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I will make this loss fuel my growth, 
absolutely. Next time—I won't stop at just 
getting even.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Not only will I claim victory, I'll 
deliver a performance leagues above the 
rest."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
B-But my actual running was really good, 
wasn't it? Way better than everyone around 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Besides, um... weren't you shocked...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I have no time to dwell on such feelings. 
If I cannot turn this humiliation into 
strength, then from the start, I never had 
what it—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't even have the right to run.
choice_data_list:
Don't you think saying you're 'not 
qualified to run' is a bit much...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega merely gave me a cold glance 
in response.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she was defeated, her running and 
mental fortitude were beyond anything 
expected of a newly debuted Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Ayabe-san's running today was 
truly incredible, wasn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The result was disappointing, but the 
difference in strength was stark.
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no doubt about that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, despite going through 
something so shocking, instead of being 
depressed, she's firing herself up 
instead...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
She isn't just fast. Her mental fortitude 
is truly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I can honestly say I have nothing but 
respect for her. Just what is... the 
secret behind this strength?
choice_data_list: I wonder if she can see it—the goal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The goal? Do you mean... of the race?
choice_data_list: No, the goal I'm aiming for myself...

No, the goal that you yourself are aiming 
for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her resolve is on a completely different 
level from other Umamusume. It might just 
be her personality, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While many other Umamusume were still 
groping in the dark, her eyes were already 
fixed firmly on her goal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my excitement still hasn't 
settled down. Even though I haven't even 
debuted yet...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the current gap between 
Ayabe-san and me...
choice_data_list: Looks a little tough to chase them, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true at all! That's 
Ayabe-san for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My desire to catch up has grown even 
stronger! Let's do our best, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's Top Road for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stars unleashed upon the racecourse. 
First-magnitude stars and comical stars 
alike. Each with their own unique charm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road's admiration for Admire 
Vega grew even deeper, and she vowed to 
chase after her back.
